# Koofr Cloud Storage Suite

> Koofr Cloud Storage Suite is a professional file management and secure cloud storage platform designed for privacy-focused teams, multi-cloud workflows, cross-platform accessibility, and streamlined data organization across modern digital environments.

## About Koofr Cloud Storage Suite

Koofr Cloud Storage Suite is built for individuals, remote teams, agencies, content creators, and enterprises who require secure, vendor-independent file organization. The project focuses on improving data accessibility while maintaining strong privacy standards and scalable infrastructure.

Koofr Cloud Storage Suite allows teams to store files, connect multiple external clouds (Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive), share links with expiration dates and passwords, and manage structured folder hierarchies. The platform supports direct file streaming, mobile backups, and efficient management of distributed content ecosystems.

The purpose of Koofr Cloud Storage Suite is to simplify cross-cloud file operations while delivering strong performance, GDPR compliance, and extensible architecture. It supports professional workflows where data control and long-term scalability are essential.

Koofr Cloud Storage Suite is commonly used in privacy-first projects, distributed team environments, media archives, personal backup systems, educational platforms, digital agencies, and multi-cloud publishing workflows.

## Configuration

Koofr Cloud Storage Suite supports highly customizable storage environments and structured data management workflows.

Configuration options may include:

- Multi-cloud account linking (Google, Dropbox, OneDrive)
- Centralized management of shared link policies
- Dynamic file streaming without local downloads
- Administrative access controls for team members
- Link password and expiration visibility conditions
- Flexible configuration for European privacy compliance
- Structured export and import workflows for file migration
- Optimized project organization for large-scale storage deployments
- Performance-oriented file indexing strategies
- Clean separation between storage logic and access layers

Koofr Cloud Storage Suite can be adapted for lightweight personal backups, enterprise document systems, agency collaboration, educational file sharing, and highly customized digital asset management.

## Tech Stack

- Language: Python, JavaScript
- Frameworks / Libraries: Vue.js, Django
- Frontend Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, modern web APIs
- Backend Architecture: Modular cloud storage integration
- Data Management: Structured file organization with external cloud connectors
- Deployment Environment: European GDPR-compliant infrastructure
- Workflow Support: Collaborative sharing and link management
- Interface Design: Responsive administrative file system
- Compatibility: All modern browsers and mobile platforms

Koofr Cloud Storage Suite is designed with flexibility, maintainability, and long-term project scalability in mind.
